nodes.instruction: Build a small usable wooden house near the initial spawn and craft an iron pickaxe from self-mined iron, using only ordinary survival actions.

criteria.description: The finished house exists and is usable
An iron pickaxe is in the current inventory from the self-mined iron chain
The iron ore mining step was completed
The raw-iron smelting step was completed
An iron pickaxe is in the current inventory
The home is saved and a tested return route exists
The 5x5 floor at level 103 is present in the current world
The outer walls at levels 104 and 105 are present in the current world
The roof at level 106 is present in the current world
Both door cells contain a birch door in the current world
The interior is clear in the current world
The outside approach is clear in the current world
The approach support cell is present in the current world

nodes.instruction: Convert enough gathered birch logs into birch planks for the house shell, using the two already-gathered planks as the base stock.

criteria.description: At least 67 birch planks are in inventory

nodes.instruction: Craft a suitable stone pickaxe using available cobblestone and sticks so exposed iron ore can be mined for raw iron.

criteria.description: At least one stone pickaxe is in inventory

nodes.instruction: Survey a stable nearby site for a modest 5 by 5 outer wooden house with a clear interior and a door approach. If any foundation cell at Y=102 beneath the house footprint is not a solid support block, fill it with dirt or another solid block first. Then verify that every foundation cell at Y=102 is a solid support block, the air clearance above is clear, and the door approach is clear.

criteria.description: Every foundation cell at Y=102 beneath the 5x5 house footprint is a solid support block
The air volume above the proposed floor at Y=104 through Y=106 is clear for walls and roof
The door approach cells at (27,104,1) and (27,105,1) are clear air

nodes.instruction: Build the 5x5 outer wooden house with supported floor, two-block-high walls, complete roof, two-cell wooden door, and clear interior.

criteria.description: The house floor is present
The walls and door are present
The roof is complete

nodes.instruction: Clear the 3x3 interior and door approach vegetation so blocks can be placed on a supported floor.

criteria.description: The planned interior and door approach cells at floor level are clear

nodes.instruction: Place a supported birch-plank floor for the 5x5 house at level 103, preserving the clear interior and door approach, and place a birch-plank support block at the door approach cell (27, 103, 1).

criteria.description: The entire 5x5 floor at level 103 is birch planks
The door approach support cell is a birch plank

nodes.instruction: Build the two-block-high outer birch-plank walls at levels 104 and 105 and install a birch wooden door in the two-cell entrance on the west side.

criteria.description: The outer wall cells at levels 104 and 105 are birch planks except the door cells
Both door cells contain a birch door
The interior remains clear at levels 104 and 105
The outside approach remains clear

nodes.instruction: Cover the 5x5 house with a complete birch-plank roof at level 106 and keep the interior below it clear.

criteria.description: The entire level-106 outer footprint is roofed
The interior remains clear beneath the roof

nodes.instruction: Demonstrate that the house is usable by entering through the door to the interior center and then exiting to the outside approach.

criteria.description: The body enters the interior center
The body exits to the outside approach

nodes.instruction: Navigate from outside through the door and stand at the interior center of the house.

criteria.description: The body is at the interior center
The body is alive
The interior remains clear

nodes.instruction: Navigate from the interior center through the door to the outside approach.

criteria.description: The body is at the outside approach
The body is alive
The outside approach remains clear

nodes.instruction: Locate exposed iron ore through surface-level finds, mine at least three raw iron from actual exposed iron ore, and avoid buried-cell probing. The body currently has 2 raw_iron; mine at least 1 more from exposed iron ore.

criteria.description: At least three raw iron are in inventory
The body is alive

nodes.instruction: Craft a furnace if needed, smelt the raw iron in it, and keep the resulting iron ingots in inventory.

criteria.description: At least three iron ingots are in inventory
The body is alive

nodes.instruction: Craft an iron pickaxe from the smelted iron ingots.

criteria.description: An iron pickaxe is in the current inventory
The raw-iron smelting step was completed
The iron ore mining step was completed

nodes.instruction: Save the home location and verify a tested route returning from the home to near the initial spawn.

criteria.description: The body can return near the initial spawn
The body is alive

nodes.instruction: Craft a crafting table from available wood to enable 3x3 recipes.

criteria.description: At least one crafting table is in inventory

nodes.instruction: Recover from the death by confirming a dry stable landing at the current respawn position (-8, 119, 10) and verifying the body is alive with sufficient health and food. The body is standing on a grass_block floor at (-8, 118, 10) with air clearance above at (-8, 120, 10).

criteria.description: The body is alive
The body has health above 10
The body has sufficient food for recovery
The body is standing on a solid block
The body has air clearance above
